findings.detail: The nonaccrual artifact counts 17 positions, but Navigator Acquiror is included even though its current-period schedule row carries footnotes (4)(7)(9), not the nonaccrual footnote marker (17).

rationale: The source artifact lists 17 nonaccrual positions. Targeted source review shows current-period nonaccrual-marked rows carrying footnote (17), for example Atlas CC Acquisition Corp. at table 41 row 7. The artifact's Navigator Acquiror entry does not carry that marker in the raw schedule; its current-period row has only footnotes (4)(7)(9). Therefore the nonaccrual list/count is overstated by one and the error is localized to Navigator Acquiror.
